mail_location.description: Mailbox format and path template. Use %u (user), %d (domain), %h (home).

auth_mechanisms.description: SASL authentication mechanisms. Use 'plain' only with TLS (SSL/TLS required).

password.description: Password for database user. Use strong secret management in production.

pgsql.password_query.default: SELECT username, password FROM users WHERE username = '%u' AND active = true
pgsql.password_query.description: SQL query to fetch password hash. Must return 'username' and 'password' columns.

pgsql.user_query.default: SELECT username, home, uid, gid, mail FROM users WHERE username = '%u' AND active = true
pgsql.user_query.description: SQL query for user info. Must return 'username', 'home', 'uid', 'gid', 'mail' columns.

enable_doveadm.description: Enable doveadm service for remote admin (e.g., quota reset, mailbox listing).

ssl_key_path.description: Path to SSL private key file.

ssl_ca_path.description: Optional path to CA certificate bundle for client cert verification.

log_path.description: Path for error and debug logs.

mail_process_count.description: Maximum number of mail processes per user session.

mail_max_userip_connections.description: Max IMAP/POP3 connections per user+IP pair. Reduce to prevent abuse.

login_greeting.description: Greeting banner sent by login services.

login_trusted_networks.description: List of trusted IP ranges (CIDR) for SMTP relay or internal use. Leave empty for none.

login_host.description: Public hostname exposed in login responses (e.g., mail.example.com).

login_local_name.description: Internal hostname used for TLS certificate verification.

mail_charset.description: Default character set for mail processing.

first_valid_uid.description: Minimum UID allowed for mail storage access.

last_valid_uid.description: Maximum UID allowed for mail storage access.

disable_plaintext_auth.description: If true, reject authentication without TLS. Strongly recommended.

imap_port.description: Port for unencrypted IMAP (only if TLS disabled or STARTTLS).

doveadm_port.description: Port for doveadm remote admin service (requires authentication).

sql_driver_args.default: driver=pgsql connect=host=%h port=%p dbname=%d user=%u password=%w
sql_driver_args.description: Args passed to SQL driver (used when external config is not used).
